newsitem.title: ITALY: Police arrest Naples area crime boss.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest Naples area crime boss.

text.p: Giuseppe Polverino, one of the most wanted members of the Naples-area Mafia, was arrested on Tuesday morning when police stormed his hideout, police said.
Polverino, who had been on the run for five years, was a top boss of the Camorra, the Naples-area version of the Mafia whose business is based on drug trafficking and extortion.
Palverino, who was arrested in an apartment in a hilly neighbourhood overlooking the Bay of Naples, was believed to be the boss of the crime group in the urban part of the city.
He has been the target of numerous arrest warrants by magistrates, including one on charges of Mafia-style criminal association.

In recent months the Naples area has been the scene of a number of murders which investigators believe are part of warfare between the Polverino clan and that headed by another Camorra boss, Giovanni Alfieri.
